correctness.rationale: Verified exact quadrant dynamics with conserved E_−=(x²+y²)/2−k|x| in y<0 and E_+=(x²+y²)/2+k|x| in y>0. Starting at (A,0), a transverse lower axis crossing x=0 requires E_−=A(A−2k)/2>0, i.e. A>2k; at equality first arc x=k+k cos t hits origin at t=π. For A>2k, four explicit sinusoidal arcs join at (0,−sqrt[A(A−2k)]), (−A,0), (0,sqrt[A(A+2k)]), (A,0), with nonzero crossing speeds and unique transverse Filippov continuation. Thus P(A)=A, period 2 acos(−k/(A−k))+2 acos(k/(A+k)); differentiation yields 2k[(A+k)^{-1}(A(A+2k))^{-1/2}−(A−k)^{-1}(A(A−2k))^{-1/2}]<0. Endpoint limits 2π+2acos(1/3) and 2π. Independent symbolic endpoint substitution and sample numerical sign checks agree; analytic inequalities—not a finite grid—prove result for all k>0 and A>2k.
